description: This Java source file defines the OfficeHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing office entities within the Fineract project. It includes methods to retrieve, create, update, and handle office data, often interacting with REST endpoints and handling JSON serialization/deserialization. It also contains deprecated methods suggesting a transition towards a different client library.

classes.name: OfficeHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing offices in Fineract via REST API, supporting retrieve, create, update operations, and file handling related to office imports.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeByID
methods.description: Retrieves office details by ID via a GET request.

methods.name: getHeadOffice
methods.description: Fetches the head office information, identified by a constant ID.

methods.name: createOffice
methods.description: Creates a new office with a specified opening date.

methods.name: createOfficeWithExternalId
methods.description: Creates a new office with an external ID and opening date.

methods.name: updateOffice
methods.description: Updates an existing office's name and opening date.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves office details using an external ID, via Fineract client.

methods.name: updateOfficeUsingExternalId
methods.description: Updates office details via external ID using Fineract client.

methods.name: getAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for office creation or update, given an opening date.

methods.name: importOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an office import template file to the server.

methods.name: getOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the output template location for an import document.

methods.name: getOfficeWorkBook
methods.description: Downloads an office template as an Excel workbook, given a date format.
